card.title: Debts on the Scoreboard
card.instruction: Treat past wins and losses as debts. Let each new result change who owes the next favor, risk, or concession.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You won our tennis match, so you owe me first choice of film.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You won the rematch this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it's your choice. Apparently I spent two hours earning your submarine documentary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll watch all three. But if you beat me tomorrow, you owe me the director's commentary on my musical.
